name: Plan Catalog Email Capture -> Twenty + Email + Telegram

parameters.content:
## Before you activate this workflow

Derived from 'Website Contact Form -> Twenty + Email + Telegram' (automation/contact-form-workflow.json) — same pattern, lighter payload: email only, no name/phone/sport.

**Updated Aug 6, 2026 — the form's purpose changed and this workflow changed with it.** The plan pages used to offer "we'll email you this plan", which was never something we could deliver. They now ask "not sure this plan is for you? leave your email and we'll help you choose." Three consequences, already applied below:

1. `excludeFromSequence` is now **false**. Someone asking for help choosing has explicitly asked to be contacted — that is a warm lead, same as a contact-form submission. (Note: these leads have no phone, and twenty_followup_check.py skips no-phone leads, so they get the email sequence and are self-excluded from WhatsApp outreach. No extra guard needed.)
2. The reply email no longer "sends the plan". It asks the three questions needed to actually recommend one (goal + date, days per week, recent training), in the reader's own language.
3. `preferredLanguage` now maps es/en/pt -> SPANISH/ENGLISH/PORTUGUESE. **This was a bug**: the node passed the raw two-letter code straight into a Twenty enum that only accepts the long form.

**Still to do before activating:**

- Twenty Settings -> Data Model -> Person -> add `PLAN_CATALOG` to the `leadSource` enum (existing: COACHMATCH, WEBSITE_FORM, REFERRAL, OTHER). Confirm with a real API call first — exact curl in plan-lead-pipeline-runbook.md.
- Reuse the contact-form workflow's 3 credentials: `Twenty API` (HTTP Header Auth), `Gmail SMTP`, `Telegram bot`.
- Set TWENTY_BASE_URL and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in the 'Config' node.
- `name.firstName` falls back to the email's local part ('javier' from javier@gmail.com) since no name is collected. Confirm Twenty accepts lastName '-'.
- The payload now carries `placement` (buybox | helpbox) — which of the two forms on the plan page was used. It lands in leadNotes.

={{ ({es: 'Hola,

Gracias por escribirnos. Vimos que estabas mirando este plan:

' + $('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.plan_name + '
' + $('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.page_url + '

Para recomendarte el plan correcto necesito tres cosas:

1) Cual es tu objetivo y en que fecha es la carrera
2) Cuantos dias por semana puedes entrenar
3) Que vienes haciendo ultimamente (volumen, ritmos, si vienes de una pausa)

Responde a este mail con eso y te digo cual de los planes te sirve, o si conviene otro.

Ivan Koch - Triaperformance', en: 'Hi,

Thanks for getting in touch. I saw you were looking at this plan:

' + $('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.plan_name + '
' + $('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.page_url + '

To point you at the right plan I need three things:

1) Your goal and the date of the race
2) How many days a week you can train
3) What you have been doing lately (volume, paces, whether you are coming back from a break)

Just reply to this email with those and I will tell you which of the plans fits, or if another one suits you better.

Ivan Koch - Triaperformance', pt: 'Ola,

Obrigado por escrever. Vi que voce estava olhando este plano:

' + $('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.plan_name + '
' + $('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.page_url + '

Para indicar o plano certo eu preciso de tres coisas:

1) Seu objetivo e a data da prova
2) Quantos dias por semana voce consegue treinar
3) O que voce vem fazendo ultimamente (volume, ritmos, se esta voltando de uma pausa)

Responda este email com isso e eu digo qual dos planos serve, ou se outro e melhor.

Ivan Koch - Triaperformance'})[$('Webhook - Plan Lead').item.json.body.language] }}
